ci_max_wait_secs.label: Longest wait for CI (seconds)
ci_max_wait_secs.help: The longest Orqen waits for CI to finish before it stops waiting and flags the run.

ci_no_pipeline_grace_secs.label: Wait for a pipeline to appear (seconds)
ci_no_pipeline_grace_secs.help: How long Orqen waits for a pipeline to appear after a push before it treats the branch as having none.

ci_poll_interval_secs.label: CI poll interval (seconds)
ci_poll_interval_secs.help: How often Orqen checks the pipeline status while waiting for CI.

docs_linked_pages_per_run.label: Linked pages read per run
docs_linked_pages_per_run.help: How many pages linked from the issue Orqen reads for each run. 0 reads none.

docs_max_page_bytes.label: Largest page read (bytes)
docs_max_page_bytes.help: The largest size of a single document page Orqen will read; bigger pages are skipped.

docs_sync_interval_secs.label: Document sync interval (seconds, 0 = off)
docs_sync_interval_secs.help: How often linked documents are refreshed. 0 turns document sync off.

graph_inferred_retention_days.label: Keep stale inferred links (days)
graph_inferred_retention_days.help: How long inferred links that are no longer confirmed are kept before they are removed.

host_idle_stop_secs.label: Stop the idle host after (seconds)
host_idle_stop_secs.help: How long the orchestrator host may sit idle before Orqen stops it to free resources.

host_orchestrator_effort.label: Orchestrator effort
host_orchestrator_effort.help: How much effort the orchestrator model puts into each turn: low, medium or high.

host_orchestrator_model.label: Orchestrator model
host_orchestrator_model.help: The model the orchestrator uses. Leave empty to use the host's default.

host_turn_timeout_secs.label: Host turn time limit (seconds)
host_turn_timeout_secs.help: The time limit for one orchestrator turn; a turn that runs longer is cut off.

knowledge_author.label: Knowledge author
knowledge_author.help: Who writes knowledge drafts: a deterministic template or the roles author.

knowledge_compaction_threshold.label: Records needed before merging
knowledge_compaction_threshold.help: How many related records must pile up before Orqen proposes merging them into one.

knowledge_learn_on_merge.label: Draft knowledge when a merge request merges
knowledge_learn_on_merge.help: Whether Orqen drafts knowledge from the work once its merge request has merged.

knowledge_promotion_business.label: Business knowledge promotion
knowledge_promotion_business.help: Whether business knowledge drafts are promoted automatically, on request only, or never.

knowledge_promotion_experience.label: Experience promotion
knowledge_promotion_experience.help: Whether experience notes are promoted automatically, on request only, or never.

knowledge_promotion_project.label: Project knowledge promotion
knowledge_promotion_project.help: Whether project knowledge drafts are promoted automatically, on request only, or never.

knowledge_promotion_sprint.label: Sprint knowledge promotion
knowledge_promotion_sprint.help: Whether sprint knowledge drafts are promoted automatically, on request only, or never.

knowledge_promotion_task.label: Task knowledge promotion
knowledge_promotion_task.help: Whether task knowledge drafts are promoted automatically, on request only, or never.

knowledge_retrieval_cache_ttl_secs.label: Search cache lifetime (seconds)
knowledge_retrieval_cache_ttl_secs.help: How long a knowledge search result is reused before the search runs again. 0 turns the cache off.

knowledge_retrieval_include_stale.label: Include stale knowledge in searches
knowledge_retrieval_include_stale.help: Whether knowledge marked stale can still appear in search results.

knowledge_retrieval_max_age_days.label: Oldest knowledge returned (days)
knowledge_retrieval_max_age_days.help: Knowledge older than this is left out of searches. 0 means no age limit.

knowledge_retrieval_max_source_bytes.label: Largest source quoted (bytes)
knowledge_retrieval_max_source_bytes.help: The most text quoted from a single knowledge source in a search result.

knowledge_retrieval_strategy.label: Retrieval strategy
knowledge_retrieval_strategy.help: How knowledge is found for a run: scoped text search, pinned records only, or off.

knowledge_retrieval_top_k.label: Results per search
knowledge_retrieval_top_k.help: How many results a knowledge search returns at most.

knowledge_wiki_sandbox.label: Wiki sandbox
knowledge_wiki_sandbox.help: Whether the wiki reader must run inside the sandbox (enforce) or may run without it when unavailable (best_effort).

publish_commit_author_email.label: Commit author email
publish_commit_author_email.help: The email address Orqen puts on the commits it publishes.

publish_commit_author_name.label: Commit author name
publish_commit_author_name.help: The author name Orqen puts on the commits it publishes.

retention_derived_cache_days.label: Keep derived caches (days)
retention_derived_cache_days.help: How long derived caches are kept before they are cleaned up.

retention_outbox_days.label: Keep processed index rows (days)
retention_outbox_days.help: How long already processed index rows are kept before they are cleaned up.

review_on_foreign_push.label: When someone else pushes
review_on_foreign_push.help: What happens when someone other than Orqen pushes to the branch: verify again, or ask a person in the Inbox.

roles_max_dispatches_per_run.label: Most role dispatches per run
roles_max_dispatches_per_run.help: The most role dispatches one run may use; the run stops asking for more after this.

roles_max_wall_secs.label: Role time limit (seconds)
roles_max_wall_secs.help: The total time limit for the roles in one run.

roles_poll_interval_secs.label: Role poll interval (seconds)
roles_poll_interval_secs.help: How often Orqen checks on running roles.

verification_allow_baseline_failures.label: Allow failures that already existed
verification_allow_baseline_failures.help: Whether failures that already existed before the change are tolerated instead of blocking the run.

verification_max_output_bytes.label: Largest command output kept (bytes)
verification_max_output_bytes.help: The most output kept from a verification command; the rest is cut.

verification_sandbox.label: Verification sandbox
verification_sandbox.help: Whether verification commands must run inside the sandbox (enforce) or may run without it when unavailable (best_effort).
